subject: NorthShore pilot - comprehensive subprocessor roster and geo-residency

From: Aaron Blake <aaron.blake@northshorehealth.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, compliance@northshorehealth.com
Date: 2027-04-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: subprocessor inventory & residency for pilot

Hi Rishi / NSH Compliance team,

Thanks again for the quick demo — NorthShore is interested in running the two-week pilot for patient-facing summarization, and our security & privacy team has a few outstanding asks before we can spin it up in our environment. Could you send a detailed subprocessor inventory that includes:

- subprocessor name and role (e.g., observability, KMS, CDN)
- countries where processing or caching may occur
- whether any telemetry or identifiable data is routed through EU or APAC caches
- encryption at rest & key location (KMS/HSM region)
- whether you have contractual flowdowns for subprocessors (yes/no) and SOC 2 evidence

We need this packaged for our procurement/privacy review by COB 2027-04-22. If there are configuration flags we can set to enforce US-only residency for the pilot, call that out separately.

Also please attach any relevant certificates (SOC 2, ISO) and a simple dataflow diagram for the pilot config. Happy to hop on a 30-min review call — proposed windows: 2027-04-21 11:00 ET or 15:00 ET.

Appreciate it —
Aaron Blake
Director, Information Security
NorthShore Health
aaron.blake@northshorehealth.com

On Mon, Apr 19, 2027 at 2:20 PM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com> wrote:
> Rishi: can you prepare...

Hi all — attaching the initial inventory and a simplified dataflow. Notes below; see CSV for per-vendor fields.

Attachment: subprocessor_inventory_20270420.csv (CSV, 47KB)
Attachment: dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

Quick summary of items of interest to NSH compliance:
1) Telemetry / metrics: We use TelemetryEdge (3rd party analytics) for aggregated metrics. TelemetryEdge has optional EU caching nodes that are used for optimization in EU customers. For this pilot, metrics are pseudonymized (no patient identifiers) and are rolled up before export. If NSH requires, we can set the cluster flag cache_region_policy=us-only for your tenant which prevents routing through EU caches.

2) KMS / keys: Primary KMS provider is KeyStone KMS. We maintain HSM-backed key material in us-east-1 by default. For customers with residency needs we can enable an on-prem HSM integration or host KMS in a specified region (e.g., us-east-1) and lock key provisioning for the tenant. Column "kms_region" in the CSV indicates current hosting.

3) Observability / logs: Observability vendor LogLane keeps short-lived traces. Traces for the pilot are configured to be aggregated and retained for 30 days; sensitive payloads are redacted before sending. See the CSV column "encryption_at_rest" and "data_types_processed" for per-vendor details.

4) Contractual flowdowns: For all processors that handle telemetry or production data we have standard subprocessor agreements; most include flowdown clauses for security and data handling. The CSV column "contractual_flowdown" is populated with Y/N. For any vendor marked 'N' we provide a mitigation note.

Next steps / asks for Rishi: please review the CSV notes and confirm whether we should drop any non-essential vendors for the pilot or require DocuSign addenda.

Laura Bennett
Privacy Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

--
Attachment stubs: subprocessor_inventory_20270420.csv (see CSV), dataflow_diagram_v2.pdf

From: Aaron Blake <aaron.blake@northshorehealth.com>

Cc: compliance@northshorehealth.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-20T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NorthShore pilot - comprehensive subprocessor roster and geo-residency

Thanks Laura & team — this is helpful. A few quick confirmations before our procurement/privacy review:

- SOC 2: please attach your SOC 2 report or a redacted snapshot we can share with our procurement team (we need evidence of controls).
- US-only pilot enforcement: Laura — your note about cache_region_policy=us-only sounds like the right control. Can you confirm that when set it is enforced at the tenant routing layer and that TelemetryEdge will not use EU caches for NSH traffic? We need that in writing for the procurement packet.
- Contractual flowdowns: if most processors have flowdown clauses, please point out one or two exceptions and confirm mitigation (e.g., no PII, or only aggregated metrics).

Assuming we get the SOC2 doc and a short confirmation about the cache flag, we can proceed with the pilot start paperwork. Let's tentatively take the 2027-04-21 11:00 ET slot for a 30-min review call — I will send a calendar invite if that works.

Please also send the DocuSign link for any DPA addendum you prefer to use (we can sign remotely).

Thanks —
Aaron Blake
Director, Information Security
NorthShore Health
